summary_en: 156,200 shares (1.18% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-28 at ¥1,280/share ceiling (¥199.9M aggregate limit). Settlement same day. Part of authorized 500,000-share program (3.77% S/O) approved 2026-07-27.
title_en: Notice of Share Repurchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-27, SERAKU's board authorized a share repurchase program and, as part of that authority, designated specific terms for an immediate block acquisition. The company will place a buy order for up to 156,200 shares via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours electronic trading) on 2026-07-28 at 08:45 JST, using the prior day's closing price of ¥1,280/share as the ceiling. The aggregate amount authorized for this block does not exceed ¥199.9M. Results will be disclosed at market close on 2026-07-28. The block purchase is part of a larger 500,000-share program (¥500M limit) approved by the same board meeting, which runs from 2026-07-28 through 2026-06-30 and permits both ToSTNeT-3 and open-market methods. The 156,200 shares represent 1.18% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock); no comparative or stated rationale is provided in the disclosure.
